newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end not far from record high.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end not far from record high.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks jumped Wednesday as Wall Street was relieved that the Federal Reserve said it saw no clear sign of inflation, putting the Dow Jones industrial average within less than 24 points of a new record high.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones ended up 27.74 points at 5,754.92, not far from its record close of 5,778.00 set on May 22. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 12-10 on moderate volume of 376 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
